Name: Slime Charmer Ring Mod
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]yfGt-yeh8Q0[/youtube]

[size=5][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/size]

This mod adds functionality to the Slime Charmer Ring, letting you change the color of its jewel and choose to either attract only that color slime or attract only slimes not of that color. It works with both small and large slimes. 

This mod makes it much easier to breed specific color slimes.


[size=5][u][b]Usage[/b][/u][/size]

To change the color of the jewel, equip the ring and use the mouse scroll wheel while hovering over the ring.

To set the ring to attract only that color, press the mod key (default middle mouse button) while hovering.

To set the ring to attract only slimes not of that color, press the mod key again.

To reset the ring behaviour, press the mod key again.

The current behaviour will be shown in the item tooltip, either "Attract", "Repel" or nothing.

The ring has eight different color jewels:

Green
Blue
Red
Purple
Copper
Iron
Gold
Tiger
Prismatic

The added functionality will not work with combined rings (maybe someday), and it will not work if it's not in either the left or right ring slot.


[size=5][u][b]Technical[/b][/u][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.
